newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Primakov to meet NATO chief in Jan-agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Primakov to meet NATO chief in Jan-agency.

text.p: Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov will meet NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana in late January, Interfax news agency said on Monday.
It said the meeting, which comes amid optimism in NATO that it can reach an accord with Russia by July, was agreed in a telephone conversation between Primakov and Solana.
Russia said last week it would open talks with NATO on a new security partnership between the former Cold War adversaries despite deep hostility to the alliance's plans to expand eastwards.
Solana said at the time that he hoped a deal could be on track -- or maybe agreed -- by the time of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation's Madrid summit in July.
Interfax, quoting the foreign ministry's press department, said Solana had initiated Monday's telephone conversation.

"In relation to NATO's suggestion at the session of the alliance's council in Brussels, the first meeting between the head of the Russian foreign ministry, Yevgeny Primakov, and the Secretary General of NATO, Javier Solana, will take place in Moscow in the second half of January," it said.
